What we do

New websites, built from the ground up

No templates that look like everyone else's. Your site starts with your business — what you offer, who you serve, and what you want visitors to do.

Focused on new websites — for now

Right now Precision Web Concepts is taking on brand-new website projects — with the branding, features, and pages your business needs built in from the start, instead of a little of everything done halfway.

Custom Website Design

A site designed around your brand, your colors, and your customers — not a generic layout with your name dropped in.

  • Home, services, about & contact pages
  • Your branding, photos & story front and center
  • Clear calls, buttons & contact paths

Mobile-First & Fast

Most of your customers will find you on a phone first. Your site is built for that screen first, then scaled up to desktop.

  • Looks right on phones, tablets & computers
  • Fast load times, no clutter
  • Tap-to-call and easy-to-find contact info

Launch-Ready Setup

A website only helps if people can find it and reach you. Every build goes live ready to do its job from day one.

  • Search-friendly page titles & descriptions
  • Contact details & location easy to find
  • Walkthrough of your finished site at launch

Add to your website

Beyond the build itself, you can add these services to your project — pick the ones that fit your business.

Branding & Logo Creation

Don't have a logo yet — or ready for a sharper one? Get a logo created for your business, plus a consistent look — colors, fonts, and style — so your website and everything else match.

AI Chat Support

AI chat support integrated right into your website, so visitors can ask questions and get answers on the page — even when you're busy or closed.

Testimonials

Put the good things your customers say about you to work. Add a testimonials section to your site that showcases your real customer reviews where new visitors will see them.

Legal Documents

The legal pages a business website needs — privacy policy, terms, and similar documents — prepared and put in place as part of your build.

More services are available

These are just the most requested add-ons. If there's something you want your website to do that isn't listed here, ask about it when you call 816-681-6767 — chances are it can be built into your project.

Every build

What's included in your new website

Prices vary depending on what you want your site to do — every project is quoted up front before work begins, and half of the quote is required up front to get started. Here's what a Precision Web Concepts build covers:

01

A design that's yours

Layout, colors, and style matched to your business and the customers you want to reach.

02

Pages that explain what you do

Home, services, about, and contact pages written and arranged so visitors get it fast.

03

Built for phones first

Your site is designed for the small screen first, because that's where most customers start.

04

Easy ways to reach you

Tap-to-call phone number, clear contact details, and calls to action where visitors expect them.

05

Foundations for search

Page titles, descriptions, and structure set up so search engines can understand your site.

06

A real launch, with a walkthrough

When your site goes live, you get a walkthrough of how it works and what everything does.

Who it's for

Made for small businesses & entrepreneurs

If you're running the business yourself, you don't need an agency retainer — you need a website that works. These are the kinds of businesses a new Precision site fits best:

Trades & Home Services

Contractors, plumbers, electricians, landscapers — show your services, your service area, and make the phone ring.

Restaurants & Cafés

Menus, hours, location, and photos that make people hungry — and a site that's easy to check from the car.

Salons & Barbers

Your services, your prices, your work on display — plus booking and contact details customers can act on instantly.

Consultants & Coaches

Explain what you do, who you help, and why you're the right call — with a clear next step for new clients.

Shops & Local Retail

Put your store online properly: what you carry, where you are, when you're open, and how to get in touch.

Startups & New Ventures

Launching something new? Start with a site that makes your business look established from day one.

Questions

Before you call

Do you redesign existing websites?

Right now, Precision Web Concepts is focused on brand-new websites. If you already have a site, call 816-681-6767 anyway — in many cases a fresh, purpose-built site is a better investment than patching an old one, and we can talk through which makes sense for you.

How much does a website cost?

Prices vary depending on what you want — how many pages, which features and services you add, and how much content you already have. Every project is quoted up front before any work begins, so there are no surprises, and half of the quote is required up front to start your project. Call 816-681-6767 and talk through your project to get your quote.

What extra services can I add?

Along with your new website, you can add branding and logo creation, AI chat support integrated into your site, a testimonials section for your customer reviews, and legal documents like a privacy policy and terms. More services are available too — if you have something in mind, ask about it on your call: 816-681-6767.

What do you need from me to get started?

Just a conversation to start. It helps to have your business name, what you offer, any logo or colors you already use, and photos of your work if you have them. The brief builder above is a quick way to pull those thoughts together before you call.

Will my website work on phones?

Yes — every site is built mobile-first, so it looks right and loads fast on phones first, then tablets and desktops. Your phone number is tap-to-call, so a customer who finds you can reach you in one tap.

How do I get started?

One call: 816-681-6767. Tell us about your business and what you want your website to do, and we'll take it from there — design, build, and launch.
